The '''Primtara Offensive''' was a battle that took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="RoE" /> in the [[Primtara system/Legends|Primtara system]],<ref name="Planetnamia" /> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Primtara sector/Legends|Primtara sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Anena Seertay]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action during the Primtara Offensive.<ref name="RoE" />
